assets.name: Shardling

clips.name: Idle
clips.note: Hover and kite. Face the player by turning the whole object.

clips.name: Charge
clips.note: Charging an orb (0.75 s). Fire the orb from the Eye socket at the end.

clips.name: Fire
clips.note: Recoil after firing.

clips.name: Death
clips.note: Rings drop and the core winks out; the game shatters it.

assets.notes: Pivot is the crystal centre: place it at ground + 2.4 m. States in types.js -> clips: idle=Idle, kite=Idle, charge=Charge (then spawn the orb at the Eye socket), Fire after shooting.

assets.name: Skitter

clips.name: Idle
clips.note: Idle and recover.

clips.name: Walk
clips.note: Wander (about 1.2 m/s at 1x speed).

clips.name: Run
clips.note: Chase (about 3.7 m/s at 1x speed).

clips.name: Windup
clips.note: Rears up before Lunge; the game holds this state for about 0.38 s.

clips.name: Lunge
clips.note: The bite: damage lands during this clip (0.2 s in the game).

clips.name: Hit
clips.note: Flinch; play over whatever it was doing.

clips.name: Death
clips.note: Ends curled on its side; the game then shatters it.

assets.notes: States in types.js -> clips: idle=Idle/Walk, chase=Run, windup=Windup, attack=Lunge, recover=Idle, hit flinch=Hit, death=Death. No root motion: the game moves the object.

assets.name: StoneWarden

clips.name: Dormant
clips.note: Asleep in the arena. Keep the eye and core emission dim.

clips.name: Wake
clips.note: 2.8 s: rises; roar peaks around 1.2 s (play the roar sound then). Ramp the eye glow up.

clips.name: Walk
clips.note: Stomp; shake the camera a little on each footfall (t = 0 and 0.5).

clips.name: SlamWindup
clips.note: 1.15 s (0.9 s in phase 2: play faster). Ramp the fist glow up.

clips.name: Slam
clips.note: 0.35 s; the fists hit at about 0.16 s: spawn the shockwave there.

clips.name: Stuck
clips.note: Fists stuck, doors open: the core is exposed (3.2x damage). The game holds this 2.7 s.

clips.name: Recover
clips.note: 0.8 s: pulls free, doors close.

clips.name: SweepWindup
clips.note: 0.85 s (0.66 s in phase 2).

clips.name: Sweep
clips.note: 0.5 s; hits between 0.14 and 0.4 s if the player is in front within 5.6 m.

clips.name: VolleyWindup
clips.note: 0.95 s; then 5 orbs (7 in phase 2) from the Core socket. Doors part slightly.

clips.name: Summon
clips.note: 2 s; roar and spawn the adds at about 1.1 s.

clips.name: Hit
clips.note: Small flinch: the Warden cannot be staggered.

clips.name: Death
clips.note: 2.8 s: collapses forward and sinks; fade the eye and core out, burst rock particles.

assets.notes: States in warden.js -> clips: dormant=Dormant, waking=Wake, chase=Walk/Idle, slamWind=SlamWindup, slam=Slam, stuck=Stuck, recover=Recover, sweepWind=SweepWindup, sweep=Sweep, volleyWind=VolleyWindup, summon=Summon. Phase 2 (below half health) plays the windups 1.28x faster. Orbiting rocks are the separate WardenRocks model.

assets.name: Thornback

clips.name: Walk
clips.note: Wander (about 1 m/s).

clips.name: Run
clips.note: Chase (about 2.8 m/s).

clips.name: Paw
clips.note: Pawing before a charge (0.95 s in the game). Pulse the thorn glow here.

clips.name: Charge
clips.note: Charging (11.5 m/s).

clips.name: Skid
clips.note: Braking after a charge that hit (0.5 s).

clips.name: Dazed
clips.note: After hitting a tree or rock: takes 1.6x damage. Spawn the circling stars at the Head socket.

clips.name: Gore
clips.note: Close-range attack: tusk toss lands at about 0.55 s.

clips.name: Death
clips.note: Topples onto its side.

assets.notes: States in types.js -> clips: idle=Idle/Walk, chase=Run, paw=Paw, charge=Charge, skid=Skid, dazed=Dazed, gore=Gore. While dazed it takes 1.6x damage. Pulse the thorns' emission during Paw/Charge from code.

assets.name: WardenRocks
assets.notes: Orbit each child around the Warden (radius 2.8-3.8 m, heights 1-5 m) from code; they rise with the Wake clip (web: rocks drift up as it wakes).

assets.name: Pell

clips.name: Idle
clips.note: At the camp, turning to face the player (rotate the object).

clips.name: Talk
clips.note: Loop while her dialogue panel is open.

clips.name: Wave
clips.note: The gesture when a quest starts (npc.js gesture).

assets.notes: Unity: import with Rig > Animation Type = Humanoid; the T-pose and bone names auto-map. Her clips convert to muscle space, and stock humanoid clips retarget onto her.

assets.name: Blade_Aether
assets.notes: Aether Blade (damage x1.0). The starting blade: straight, slim, cyan. Grip centred on the origin; Base/Tip empties give the blade segment for the sweep test. The _Glow child uses AF_Glow: give it an additive shader.

assets.name: Blade_Skybreaker
assets.notes: Skybreaker (damage x2.4, costs 80 shards). Crystal shards strung on a glowing core. Grip centred on the origin; Base/Tip empties give the blade segment for the sweep test. The _Glow child uses AF_Glow: give it an additive shader.

assets.name: Blade_Sunforged
assets.notes: Sunforged Blade (damage x1.8, costs 40 shards). Broad golden blade with a sun-disc guard. Grip centred on the origin; Base/Tip empties give the blade segment for the sweep test. The _Glow child uses AF_Glow: give it an additive shader.

assets.name: Blade_Tempered
assets.notes: Tempered Aether Blade (damage x1.35, costs 18 shards). Longer and slimmer, with a glowing fuller. Grip centred on the origin; Base/Tip empties give the blade segment for the sweep test. The _Glow child uses AF_Glow: give it an additive shader.

assets.name: Gauntlet_R

assets.name: Spire

assets.name: TrainingDummy
assets.notes: Hit sphere radius 0.45 at the Hit socket. On a hit, kick the Swing child (pivot at the top) and let a spring settle it (web: makeDummy: stiffness 38, damping 4). Collider radius 0.35.

assets.name: Waystone
assets.notes: Respawn point. Bob the Crystal child (+-0.12 m at 1.6 rad/s) and spin it; glow sprite at the Glow socket. Interact radius 2.2, collider radius 0.75.
